case.summary: Case HHG-003 was triggered by customer C08623 reporting an unauthorized $49.00 in-person transaction (txn 3530164) on card C08623-K2. An investigation revealed an episode of two in-person transactions (txns 3527215 and 3530164) between 2016-12-09 12:36:58 and 2016-12-10 13:01:21 totaling $108.00 in billing region 330. This activity matched an out-of-region pattern representing only 4.3% of prior card activity while home activity continued in parallel, resulting in a calibrated fraud probability of 0.95. Card C08623-K2 was blocked and a case was created, with no SAR filing required due to the low exposure.
